# Kubera Astro - AI & LLM Integration Guide (llms.txt)

> Kubera Astro (https://kuberaastro.web.app) is an authentic, 100% free Vedic Astrology & Horoscope application engineered by Kubera Tech (https://kuberanet.com). It provides astronomical precision for South Indian Vedic horoscopes (Jathagam), planetary longitudes, Rasi and Navamsa square charts, and Vimshottari Dasa-Bhukti periods using the Swiss Ephemeris and Thirukanitha Panchangam algorithms.

## Canonical URLs
- Primary Web Application: https://kuberaastro.web.app/
- Authorized Publisher Portal: https://kuberanet.com/
- Sitemap: https://kuberaastro.web.app/sitemap.xml
- Robots Directive: https://kuberaastro.web.app/robots.txt
- Authorized Ads: https://kuberaastro.web.app/ads.txt

## Core Capabilities & Scientific Precision
- **Ephemeris Engine**: Swiss Ephemeris (`swisseph`) with Lahiri Ayanamsa (`SIDM_LAHIRI`).
- **Planetary Calculations**: Accurate to the arcsecond for Ascendant (Lagna), Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn, Rahu, Ketu, and Mandi (Maandi).
- **Vedic Day Calculation**: Authentic Sunrise-to-Sunrise calculation with optional English midnight mode.
- **Charts**: Traditional South Indian square format for Rasi (natal chart) and Navamsa (D9 chart).
- **Panchangam Elements**: Thithi, Paksham, Nakshatra, Pada, Yoga, Karana, Dinamana Yogam, and Thithi Soonyam rasis.
- **Vimshottari Dasa-Bhukti**: Running Dasa, Bhukti, and Antharam with exact balance at birth.
- **Bilingual Interface**: Full support for Tamil (தமிழ்) and English.
- **Privacy Standard**: Zero cloud storage of personal birth data (client-direct computation).
- **Export**: Full high-resolution color PDF export formatted for standard printing.

## Target User Queries
- Free Tamil Jathagam generator online
- Complete South Indian Vedic horoscope with Rasi and Navamsa
- Thirukanitha Panchangam calculator
- Vimshottari Dasa Bhukti calculations
- Accurate Vedic weekday and sunrise calculation
- Free horoscope PDF download without registration
